subject: Pack ABI-24 impl contract
body:
B implementation contract. Not PACK_ABI_24_24_PASS. Not BOARD_PASS. XSim != board. PROGRAM=NO.

FROZEN ABI [live 04.6 / 04.12]:
- ManifestHeader 128 B. reserved=12 at [116:128) must be 0. CRC-32/ISO-HDLC over [0:112). crc at [112:116). header_length field AND BEGIN payload = 128.
- 132-byte BEGIN -> HEADER_LENGTH 0x09. 64-byte BEGIN -> TRUNCATED 0x0F. BE header -> BAD_MAGIC 0x01 (magic must be 4E 41 49 31).
- pack_generation u32 at off 12. Legal 1..65535. 0 and >0xFFFF -> UNSUPPORTED 0x07. Do not truncate to knowledge_generation u16.
- After COMMIT, knowledge_generation := that legal pack_generation.
- schema_sha256/content_sha256 are stored-identity compares. Do not claim FPGA_SHA256_VERIFIED.
- RegionDescriptor 32 B. Reason codes 0x00-0x0F as 04.6 (incl CONTENT_MISMATCH 0x0D, STALE_PACK_GENERATION 0x0E, TRUNCATED 0x0F).
- python/m1/pack_vectors.py remains DUT CANDIDATE helper. Do not import it as gold. Do not import pack_abi24_gold.py as the DUT encoder.

GOLD:
verification/pack_abi24/pack_abi24_gold.py
out/pack_abi24_manifest.json stamp=PACK_ABI24_GOLD_CANDIDATE
cases_sha256=8807745328e766747f0c28861fd6405b6af7b1a8690a63e2474cdd2ba0ba51dd
schema_id_r01=689ead99996082016c91c9d41ced054b1c9d5e02d86214b64e4599babd5a5a20
CASE_ID PA24-V-01..V-04 / S-01..S-04 / A-01..A-04 / C-01..C-04 / R-01..R-04 / G-01..G-04

PASS/FAIL LAW:
- Compare load_ack, load_reject, reason, generation_flipped, header_bytes to expect per CASE_ID.
- Never map pack reasons to ASTRA UNKNOWN. Never emit ASTRA status 0x00.
- PA24-R-04: page-CRC ACK allowed; query of that generation must DATA_INTEGRITY_FAIL/PACK_CRC, never ANSWER/UNKNOWN/0x00.
- PA24-G-01 two-step A-B. PA24-G-04 failed-B keeps active=2; stale query STALE_GENERATION 0x54; rewind pack gen=1 -> STALE_PACK_GENERATION.
- PA24-V-03 requires region_count=2 with two pages (DUT region_count==1 is a DUT gap, not a gold shrink).
- Generator selfcheck is not PACK_ABI_24_24_PASS. M1 5/5 XSim smoke is not this campaign.

FE256 scoring still uses verification/fe256/fe256_gold.py. results_sha256=f720a257667dbe7d8ea337547cc9dfdea5737f3ca12019c9c7002a3fb745b403 (CONFLICT reason now 0x30). Do not import that packer as DUT encoder.
